definitions.action_credit: descriptive sampled-action association of normalized advantage, NOT a counterfactual Q value
definitions.delta_value: V_{t+1} - V_t with V = value_old of the respective rows (same update, same V_old evaluation)
definitions.descriptive_only: all quantities are descriptive and non-counterfactual
definitions.future: future_component = raw_advantage - td_residual = gamma * gae_lambda * A_{t+1}; with lambda = 1 this is A_{t+1} = R - V_{t+1}
definitions.lambda1_telescoping: with gamma = 1, lambda = 1 and terminal-only reward, A_t = sum of TD residuals = R_episode - V_t and value_target = A_t + V_t = R_episode: no intermediate V_{t+k} (including a value conditioned on a different acting ego) survives in the actor's total advantage; one-step TD residuals still exist and are reported only as diagnostics
definitions.local: td_residual = transition_reward + gamma * V_next - V_t (terminal: transition_reward - V_t)
definitions.next_decision: the row with episode_decision_ordinal + 1 in the same (iteration, episode_index) global decision sequence
definitions.nonterminal: row is not its episode's last global decision (over all wake kinds)
definitions.sign: sign(x) in {-1, 0, +1}; 'differs' compares these three-valued signs
definitions.spread: pstdev (population), IQR (statistics.quantiles n=4, inclusive), and median absolute deviation about the median
definitions.within_update: per update holding both severities: mean(severe) - mean(mild); median / mean over those updates
